title: Efficacy and Safety of Single Dose of 5 mg Zoledronic Acid in Chinese Patients With Paget's Disease of Bone (PDB)
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to document the efficacy and safety profiles of single intravenous dose of 5 mg zoledronic acid for the Chinese patients of Paget's Disease of Bone (PDB).
inclusion_criteria:
inclusion criteria: 

 Confirmed diagnosis of PDB by radiological reports 

 Serum Alkaline Phosphatase level (SAP) at least two times the upper limit of the normal (ULN)
